title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Caritas Norwood Hospital
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Compnay's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, and Judith F. Judson. (DTE 05-GC-2)
